name: robloach-cogs
author: RobLoach
description: Cogs for Red-DiscordBot by RobLoach. Currently: Retro, which plays retro console games in channels, emulated with libretro.
install_msg:
The *robloach-cogs* repository has been installed.
- `[p]repo list robloach-cogs` to list of available cogs
- `[p]cog install robloach-cogs retro` to install the retro cog
